contrasts.matched_factors: Same 22-mer sequence and human platelet assay family
contrasts.scientist_interpretation: Full PS ODN2395 was strongly activating whereas the identical-sequence PO control was low/inactive, supporting a backbone contribution in this assay context.
contrasts.causal_limitation: One matched construct pair in a defined in vitro system; not a universal estimate of PS risk.
contrasts.permitted_use: Descriptive matched-contrast analysis; keep paired constructs in the same leakage group.
